fields.description: Support cannot look up refunds for orders that do not exist in our system. Acceptance criteria: a refund lookup for an unknown order returns 200 with an empty result set, not 404. A lookup for a known order with no refunds returns an empty list. Refund lookups are read-only and must never create records. Contract: specs/openapi.yaml (GET /refunds?order_id=).

comments.body: ACs are in the description as prose; please split them carefully and confirm the wording with me.
